name: Spring AI Foundry chat with managed identity

assertions: application source contains no Foundry API-key property
Container App system identity has Cognitive Services OpenAI User on the Foundry account
Container App configuration contains no Foundry key secret or API-key environment variable
Foundry network access defaults to deny and allows only Container Apps outbound IPs
GET / returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty model response
all disposable Azure resources are deleted
